plugin.name: RehearsalPlayer
plugin.title: Rehearsal Player
plugin.desc: Dark, playlist-driven rehearsal playback with tutor/class filters, artwork playlist selection, large transport controls, quick jump presets, and a Spotify-backed teacher playlist section.
plugin.changes: Fixes Spotify browsing/search broken by Spotify's February 2026 Web API changes for Development Mode apps: the playlist tracks endpoint moved from /tracks to /items (was causing 403 Forbidden), and the search results limit dropped from 50 to 10 (was causing 400 Bad Request). Also: the Add-track search box now shows the real backend error instead of always saying "No matching tracks found", and the settings page now warns in server.log if a teacher playlist's Spotify ID looks like it came from a shortened share link instead of the full playlist link.
plugin.creator: Jazzart
